chapters.label: The duel
chapters.text: Germany, 2006, a World Cup quarter-final. Luís Figo of Portugal, one of the best wingers in the world, runs at England’s Ashley Cole. Early on, Cole wins the ball!

chapters.label: Close
chapters.text: Here’s how he did it. Cole gets close. Then he slows down and stays on his feet. No diving in!

chapters.label: Down the line
chapters.text: He stays inside, so Figo can only go down the line. Figo knocks it on. Cole pokes it away!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: That’s how to shut down the best winger. Stay close, stay on your feet, and show the winger down the line.
